title: Left wheel suspended
shortDescription: Left drive wheel is off the floor.
fullDescription:
Dreame error 101 fires when the left wheel suspension is fully extended — typically high-centered on a threshold or stuck on cable.

Move the robot to flat floor and restart.

fixSteps.title: Place on flat floor
fixSteps.instruction: Move to open area and resume.

whenToCallPro: If error persists on flat floor.

faq.a: Most Dreame can climb 20-22mm thresholds.

title: Right wheel suspended
shortDescription: Right drive wheel off the floor.
fullDescription: Mirror of 101 for the right wheel. Usually a stuck threshold or cable.

fixSteps.title: Move robot
fixSteps.instruction: Place on flat floor and resume.

whenToCallPro: If persistent.

faq.a: Cable management mats and tall thresholds are common culprits.

title: Main brush jammed
fullDescription: Hair, string, or threads bound the main brush. Remove brush, clear bearings.

fixSteps.title: Clean brush
fixSteps.instruction: Pull brush, remove caps, cut hair.

whenToCallPro: If motor silent.

faq.a: Every 6-12 months.

title: Side brush jammed
fullDescription: Hair on the side brush post stalls the small motor.
whenToCallPro: Rarely.

faq.a: Every 12 months.

title: Fan / suction error
fullDescription: Either the fan is blocked or the motor is failing. Clean dust path and HEPA filter.
whenToCallPro: If filter clean and fan still under-speed.

faq.a: Some models yes — check manual.

title: Cliff sensor blocked
fullDescription: Wipe cliff sensors with dry microfiber. Avoid running on glossy black floors without no-go zones.
whenToCallPro: If error persists.

faq.a: Use no-go zone or transition mat.

title: LiDAR sensor blocked
shortDescription: LDS turret blocked or not spinning.
fullDescription: Top LiDAR turret cannot spin. Check for hair around the shaft and that nothing is on top of the robot.

fixSteps.title: Move to open area
fixSteps.instruction: Reset and place in clear room.

whenToCallPro: If LiDAR motor silent.

faq.a: Typically 3-5 years of daily use.

title: Bumper stuck
fullDescription: Tap bumper several times to free; remove debris from gap.
whenToCallPro: If switch broken.

faq.a: Yes, brief bursts only.

title: Battery low
fullDescription: After heavy use, the battery may need replacing. Clean dock contacts as a first step.
whenToCallPro: If new battery does not resolve.

faq.a: About 2 years of daily use.

title: Mop pad / water tank issue
shortDescription: Mop module not detected or water tank empty.
fullDescription:
On L20 and L10s with mop, error 110 fires if the mop module isn't seated, the water tank is dry, or the auto-wash base has issues.

Reseat mop pads, refill water, check base water lines.

fixSteps.title: Refill clean water
fixSteps.instruction: Top up with cold water (no detergent unless specified).

whenToCallPro: If base water pump is faulty.

faq.a: Only Dreame-approved cleaning solutions.
